sections.title: A trained team beats the bot team
sections.summary: One shared PPO policy flies all five blue ships against the built-in bots, each ship getting half of its teammates' kill and death rewards. It started from the single-seat agent; after 2M ship-steps of team training (under 20 minutes on 4 CPU cores) it wins 90% of battles. Training is still running; a check on battles it was never evaluated on will follow.

chart.alt: Team training progress: blue's win rate climbs from 45% to 90% and its average kill margin from -0.8 to +9.8 within 2M ship-steps; the all-bot team sits at 50% and -0.8.

sections.title: One trained agent among bots
sections.summary: A PPO agent flies blue ship 0; the other nine ships are the built-in bot. After 3.5M training steps it beats the bot playing the same seat, on 50 battles it never trained on. On its own it doesn't help a whole team: five copies win about as often as five bots, which is why the team training above was needed.

chart.alt: Training progress: the agent's average reward and kills per death rise past the bot's between 3M and 3.5M steps.
